name: vital-arcs
title: Vital Arcs
description: A daily summary widget: concentric arcs sweep from the corner with values at their tips, round a score disc.

perf.budget: The arcs are trimmed Skia paths and the badges ride them with UI-thread timings; the score counts up for about a second. Nothing animates at rest.

a11y.reducedMotion: Arcs, badges and the score appear at their values without sweeping or counting.
a11y.screenReader: Each row reads as one line ("Sleep time: 7h 2m, up 12%"), and the arcs as one summary with the score ("16 PAI. Activity 31, Workouts 84, Rest 53").
